description: This file defines several event classes related to person lifecycle events, used within an Orleans grain-based application to implement event sourcing. It includes event interface, serializers, and event data classes for person registration, marriage, and last name change.

classes.name: IPersonEvent
classes.description: Marker interface for person-related events supporting type checking

classes.name: PersonRegistered
classes.description: Event data indicating a person has registered with name and gender

classes.name: PersonMarried
classes.description: Event data indicating a person has married, including spouse information

classes.name: PersonLastNameChanged
classes.description: Event data indicating a person's last name has changed

methods.name: PersonRegistered
methods.description: Constructor initializing the registration event with names and gender

methods.name: PersonMarried
methods.description: Constructor initializing the marriage event with spouse info

methods.name: PersonLastNameChanged
methods.description: Constructor initializing the last name change event
